description: Default non-sacred DAG for the first difficult character proof. Native gates validate AXM-owned state without taking ownership of neural/generative proposal stages.

nodes.native_support: internal-native-parametric-v0.1 + internal-native-targets-v0.1 + optional verified CC0 seed data

nodes.truth_limit: Production deformation-aware retopology remains an open capability; native topology tools validate and preserve evidence but do not yet solve final organic retopology.

nodes.native_support: internal-native-pbr-v0.1 + internal-native-skin-material-v0.1 + internal-native-eye-material-v0.1 + native hair/fabric materials

nodes.truth_limit: Rig inference remains a replaceable proposal organ; AXM owns validation and deformation truth.
Cloth motion substrate is real; production garment tailoring/self-collision and hair secondary-motion quality remain open.
Morph-weight runtime delivery and corrective drivers are real; production face fitting, wrinkle semantics, teeth/tongue and final correctives remain open.
Emitter direction/state is real; final rendered VFX, exposure, smoke/lighting and gameplay timing still require engine evidence.

An experimental path carries UV/skin/morph attributes and measures posed deformation loss. Final Sentinel LOD remains blocked until its real mesh passes deformation, material/silhouette retention and engine transition gates.
AABB state is real; semantic/compound character collision remains incomplete.

nodes.native_support: internal-native-character-gltf-v0.1 + internal-native-facial-gltf-v0.1 + native hair glTF + native rigid/fabric snapshot glTF
Godot 4.7.2 pinned import/instantiation + real viewport render workflow
nodes.truth_limit: Engine parse/render receipts prove technical acceptance and visible rendered signal; they do not automatically assert aesthetic quality.
